finalproject

Jialing Yuan’s final project for BST 260, Fall 2026.

This R package contains public health datasets and their documentation. The project website is at https://jialingyuan02.github.io/finalproject/.

Installation 

devtools::install_github("JialingYuan02/finalproject")

Data

The package includes waterborne, cdcmurd, cdcfiremort, and gunleg. Their help pages document the original data sources.

data("waterborne", package="finalproject")
waterborne[[1]]

This project is based on Vincent Carey’s BST 260 project template. The original course instructions and project suggestions are included for reference.
